raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 (377 rows) is the only batch with source_tz='UTC', so its txn_ts values are UTC while every other batch is America/Chicago local time. Batch 13 samples start at 12:02, which is 06:02 Chicago and matches the other batches' 06:00 start. The evening part of that Jan 17 local business day lands after midnight UTC, so it is mis-dated into Jan 18 and shows up as 00:00-06:00 transactions. The silver step ignores source_tz, so the fix is to convert UTC rows to Chicago local time.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
